name: core.openwop.workflows.kicktodo-challenge-factory
description: The Challenge Factory (ADR 0458) + its lesson-batch child — migrated from the deprecated builtins (ADR 0472 P4, the terminal quarantine step). chainIds keep the original ids; build-0..3 reference lesson-batch via RFC 0133 config.subChainRef (host-default binds it to the shared same-id child); truthy/falsy reject-safe barriers ride RFC 0134; produced vars (plan/evidenceSummary/evidenceClaims/planBrief/planEvidenceBrief) declared per RFC 0133 §2.2; 1.4.0 (ADR 0458 §2.2 correction) grounds the plan, the lessons and the skeptic on the STRUCTURED evidence. 1.5.4 declares `actions: [approve, reject]` on all five approval gates (they set maxRequestChangesIterations 0, so those are the only real decisions — a defer/escalate/request-changes resume is now refused instead of being recorded as a decline that fails the run) and types the lesson-batch params honestly. 1.6.0: generateMedia param + image binding. 1.7.0: gate-N shows the lessons; a failed batch stops the run. 1.9.0: search uses searchQuery (ADR 0975 D3).
